ios.debug.build: npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean && xcodebuild -workspace ios/example.xcworkspace -scheme example -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build

ios.release.build: npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean && xcodebuild -workspace ios/example.xcworkspace -scheme example -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build

android.debug.build: npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug assembleAndroidTest -DtestBuildType=debug && cd ..

android.release.build: npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease assembleAndroidTest -DtestBuildType=release && cd ..
